correctness.rationale: The full rate normalization is specified; first moments solve a two-by-two linear drift. The displayed 4-by-4 second-moment stationary system follows from the generator and quadratic variations, yielding positive-denominator closed forms for all covariances. A strictly monotone positive cubic in dimensionless rate proves the unique optimum for unequal baths. Irreducible positive recurrence and finite stationary second moments follow from reservoir total-number drift and quadratic Lyapunov bound. Independent unsymmetrized exact-rational checker passed 82 equations for n=2,3, with all pair covariances matching. The finite check is not used to prove the infinite theorem.

value.rationale: A full infinite-family interacting transport model has an exactly localized optimal finite rate for a natural stationary observable, despite strictly rising mean transport current. The sharp cubic rate criterion, cross/within shore covariance ratio, and universal large-n optimizer provide a motivated nonequilibrium benchmark beyond sign inequalities or a routine isolated computation.
